items.summary: Add a 'Delete Stripe Configuration' button to the StripeSetup component (frontend/src/components/StripeSetup.tsx) that allows the admin to remove the stored Stripe API key and reset the Stripe configuration

Create a React Query mutation hook useDeleteStripeConfig in frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts that calls the backend deleteStripeConfig method and invalidates the Stripe configuration cache after successful deletion
Create a backend method deleteStripeConfig() in backend/main.mo with admin authentication that removes the stored Stripe secret key and allowed countries configuration from the StripeConfig storage
Update the StripeSetup component to refresh the configuration status after deletion and show the configuration form again when Stripe settings are removed
